message.content:
{
  "title": "The House of Futility",
  "language": "en",
  "recommended_level": "1-3",
  "hook": "A mysterious house, seemingly abandoned, but with a hidden agenda. Players must navigate through a series of rooms, each with its own unique challenges and puzzles, to uncover the house's true purpose.",
  "npcs": [
    {
      "name": "The Jester",
      "role": "Host of the house, a programmed illusion that appears in Room Four."
    },
    {
      "name": "The False Start",
      "role": "The room that appears to be the start of the house, but is actually a decoy in Room Seven."
    },
    {
      "name": "The Lever",
      "role": "A room that can only be accessed via teleportation or by destroying the door in Room Eight."
    }
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Room One: The Carpet",
    "Room Two: The Sword Room",
    "Room Three: The Teleportation Room",
    "Room Four: The Jester",
    "Room Five: The Wine-y Bard",
    "Room Six: The Treasure",
    "Room Seven: The False Start",
    "Room Eight: The Swords Again",
    "Room Nine: The Lever"
  ],
  "threats": [
    "The Jester's illusion in Room Four",
    "The Wine-y Bard's wine-filled room in Room Five",
    "The False Start's deceptive door in Room Seven",
    "The Lever's 20-foot pit drops in Room Nine"
  ],
  "rewards": [
    "500 gp in Room Six",
    "Teleportation to Room One in Room Seven",
    "Teleportation to Room One in Room Eight",
    "A lever to open a 20-foot pit drop in Room Nine"
  ]
}
